notes.title: 16/11/23 Update
notes.notes: When reporting a bug, a file explorer window opens at the log files location, which can then be uploaded on the form.

notes.title: 27/10/2023 Minor bug fixes
notes.notes:
Fixed some button hit boxes slightly offset
 Added an in game console that will pop up if an error is detected (can easily be closed with the mouse). It will make debugging easier.
 Fixed an edge case in whch the cartographer could be stuck in the cabin after a mermaid attack

notes.title: 26/10/2023 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Mouse cursor did not line up properly on non 1920x1080 screen
 Cartographer could get stuck in cabin
 Water reflection bug fixed
 When restarting a game, players could get stuck on map screens
